instruction: Studio portrait photograph, medium shot. Against a solid light blue background, three women pose closely. On the right, the afro-haired woman in a beige tank top (R3) hugs the curly-haired woman from behind, smiling widely with her chin on her shoulder. Soft studio lighting illuminates their warm skin tones.
